checks.observed: The Phase 5 PowerShell pattern explicitly excludes both the out directory and release/content-hashes.json using normalised paths relative to the resolved iac root.

checks.check: Release content-hash evidence is independent of checkout location
checks.expected: Resolved full paths are used only to read files; serialized paths are normalised iac-relative paths sorted with ordinal comparison and emitted as canonical UTF-8 JSON
checks.observed: The pattern derives each path with GetRelativePath, normalises separators to '/', ordinal-sorts the relative path array, hashes the resolved file and writes only the relative path as compact UTF-8 JSON without BOM or trailing newline. A two-checkout temporary fixture produced byte-identical output, remained stable on rerun, excluded out and the generated manifest, and contained no absolute test root.
